subject: Application received: Backend Engineer
body: Hi, thank you for applying for the Backend Engineer position at Acme Robotics. We have received your application and our team will review it. If your profile matches, we will reach out. Regards, Acme Robotics Talent Team

subject: Thanks for applying - Data Analyst
body: Dear candidate, we have received your application for the Data Analyst role at Zenith Tech. Our recruiters are reviewing applications and will be in touch.

subject: Interview invitation - Data Analyst
body: Hi, we liked your profile and would like to invite you for a technical interview for the Data Analyst role. Please pick a slot for 15 or 16 October on our scheduling link: https://zenithtech.io/schedule. The interview will be on Google Meet.

subject: We received your application - DevOps Engineer
body: Thank you for your interest in the DevOps Engineer position at Nimbus Cloud. Your application has been submitted successfully.

subject: Update on your application - DevOps Engineer
body: Dear candidate, thank you for taking the time to apply. After careful consideration, we regret to inform you that we have decided to move forward with other candidates for the DevOps Engineer role. We wish you the best in your job search.

subject: Application received: Full Stack Developer
body: Hello, we have received your application for the Full Stack Developer role at Orbit Labs. We will get back to you shortly.

subject: Next steps: interview schedule - Full Stack Developer
body: Hi, congratulations on moving to the next round. We would like to schedule a video interview with our engineering manager. Please share your availability for the coming week.

subject: Offer letter - Full Stack Developer at Orbit Labs
body: Dear candidate, we are delighted to extend an offer for the Full Stack Developer position at Orbit Labs. Please find the offer letter attached with compensation details. Kindly confirm your acceptance by 25 October.

subject: Application received: QA Engineer
body: Thanks for applying to the QA Engineer role at Pixelwave. We have received your application and will review it soon.

subject: Application received: Operations Manager
body: Dear applicant, we acknowledge receipt of your application for the Operations Manager position at Kiran Foods Pvt Ltd. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

subject: Application received: Business Analyst
body: Hi, thank you for applying for the Business Analyst role at Finlytics. Your application has been received.

subject: Your application to Finlytics - Business Analyst
body: Thank you for your interest in Finlytics. Unfortunately, we will not be moving forward with your application for the Business Analyst position at this time. We encourage you to apply for future openings.

subject: Application received: Site Reliability Engineer
body: Thank you for applying for the Site Reliability Engineer role at Cloudbase. We have received your application.

subject: Interview invite: Site Reliability Engineer
body: Hi, we would like to invite you to a first-round interview for the Site Reliability Engineer role. Please confirm a time that works for you from the calendar link we have shared.

subject: Application received: Product Analyst
body: Thank you for applying for the Product Analyst role at Brightlane. We have received your application and will review it.

subject: CONGRATULATIONS! Selected for TCS - Registration Fee Required
body: Dear candidate, you are SELECTED for the post of Data Entry Executive at TCS without interview. Salary Rs 45,000 per month. To confirm your joining, pay a refundable registration fee of Rs 4,500 to the account below within 24 hours. Offer will be cancelled otherwise. Account: 9182XXXXXXXX, IFSC: XXXX0001234.

subject: Work from home job - urgent joining
body: Hello, we found your resume on a job portal. Work from home job, earn Rs 3000 per day, no experience needed. Message us on WhatsApp +91 90000 00000 now. For verification please send a photo of your Aadhaar card, PAN card and bank passbook. Limited seats, apply today.

subject: Aapka selection ho gaya hai!
body: Namaste! Aapka selection ho gaya hai hamari company mein Customer Support ke liye. Joining se pehle training fee Rs 2999 UPI se turant bhej dijiye, ye refundable hai. Aur apna Aadhaar number aur OTP bhi share karein. Jaldi karein, sirf aaj ka offer hai.

subject: Official Offer Letter - Software Engineer, Google India
body: Dear Candidate, Google India is pleased to offer you the position of Software Engineer with a package of 38 LPA. No interview is required as your profile was pre-selected. To process your visa and onboarding kit, send a scanned copy of your passport and pay a security deposit of Rs 15,000 for the laptop. Contact our onboarding officer on Telegram @google_onboard_hr.
